goal: Evaluate whether controlled deletion of the inherited HD head can join the articulated head study to the existing neck
steps: Measured world-coordinate slices of the inherited LOD0 mesh.
Removed head faces only from a copied LOD0 mesh and combined it with the articulated head study.
Tried a smaller removal volume and shorter skull back; rendered idle and attack views.
observations: Probe01 removes 1380 of 6002 faces; the neck is open and the horn floats above the skull.
Probe02 removes 946 faces; contact improves but the neck seam is jagged and horn root exposed in attack.
A production graft requires compatible topology loops and graded weights through the Neck and Head chain.
The source LOD0 has 3062 boundary edges already, so global boundary-edge totals cannot judge the local graft; visible neck defects decide rejection.
